note: Portage County park (21 wooded acres) about 3 mi SW of Rosholt beside 42-acre Collins Lake. The sites sit in pine woods north of the park road, about 70 m or more from the shore with the road and a wooded strip between. A seasonal park manager lives in the park. Picnic lodge, boat ramp and a small swimming beach. --Claude
summary: County page, reservation site (campground page, site search, per-site pages), 2020 rules PDF, campground and park maps, imagery read. Fees none -> $25-33 (+$8 reservation fee); booking online, 11-month window, closes 7 days out then same-day in-person registration (fcfs always, cutoff in booking.note), 2-night reservation minimum + 3 on holidays, 14-night max; season May 15 - Sep 30 confirmed; 28 sites; flush toilets added. LAKEVIEW -> NOT WATERFRONT (sites ~70 m+ from the shore behind the park road and a continuous wooded strip).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront. The county's numbered campground map puts all 28 sites in pine woods NORTH of the park road; the nearest row (sites 6-9, about 44.6022-44.6024,-89.3445 to -89.3462) is about 70-75 m from Collins Lake, with the park road and a continuous wooded band ~50 m deep between, and the shoreline below it is the boat-launch/day-use side. No site photo shows the lake, so no view can be supported; default down. Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'County campground map + Esri 2026-11-16: sites 1-28 in woods north of the park road; nearest row (6-9) ~70-75 m from Collins Lake behind the road and a continuous wooded band; no photo shows the lake -> not waterfront'.
Pin 44.6018,-89.3423 sits at the park office/buildings by the shore east of the campground; the loop's centre (restroom by site 5) is about 44.6026,-89.3440, ~170 m WNW (optional move, under 250 m).

MINIMUM: the 2020 rules require two nights for reservations all season (a one-night search returned no sites); same-day walk-in registration is the other route. Written to booking.min_stay as 2 always + 3 holiday.

Sites: 28 on the booking site (the stored inclusion_evidence says '1-28 + HC'; the search lists 28). Site dimensions 34-61 ft on the per-site pages (site size, not a rig limit; a 23-ft rig fits every one); max_rig_ft not written. Electric amperage not stated.
